root_idea.summary: The root centers on lack of clarity or purity, with a distinct secondary branch of rapid, downward, or dispersed movement.
root_idea.development: The physical sense of turbidity or dinginess extends metaphorically to troubled life, disturbed feeling, and confused judgment. A separate movement branch describes hastening, pouring down, or falling in dispersal.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is presented under the normalized Form VII perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To dart downward; of stars, to fall and become scattered.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the subject is the stars; the form describes their downward fall and dispersal in 81:2.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become turbid, thick, or muddy; to cease to be clear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of water or another liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dusky or dingy in colour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a complexion, a horse, or another object whose colour becomes dusty, dark, or dingy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become troubled, perturbed, or confounded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of life or livelihood, the heart or mind, and an opinion or line of thought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour out or forth water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a distinct Form I usage reported for the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render water turbid, thick, or muddy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative use applied directly to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trouble or perturb; to confound; to sully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's life or affairs, heart or mind, an opinion, or a favour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the eye to continue looking at a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction describing sustained looking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour down upon someone or to approach them in a scattered mass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an enemy or group of people converging upon someone, with emphasis on dispersed movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten or move at a somewhat rapid pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's movement or running.
A collective noun; the noun of unity is كَدَرَةٌ.
Used of life or livelihood; the same figurative branch is also applied to a perturbed heart or mind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Duskiness or dinginess of colour; a hue inclining to black and dust-colour.
A species of the bird called قَطًا.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation refers to its dusky or dust-coloured plumage; related forms include كُدَارِيٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh milk in which dates are steeped, mashed, or macerated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A food associated with a dusky colour; it is described as being used to fatten women.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dusky or dingy; having a colour inclining to black and dust-colour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine is كَدْرَاءُ and the plural is كُدْرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wild asses, or a particular group of wild asses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional designation attributed to a particular stallion or ancestor.
